import mujoco, json
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path("mjcf.xml")
joints=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT, i)
    jt=m.jnt_type[i]
    tname={0:"free",1:"ball",2:"slide",3:"hinge"}[jt]
    axis=list(map(float,m.jnt_axis[i]))
    if m.jnt_limited[i]:
        rng=list(map(float,m.jnt_range[i]))
    else:
        rng=None
    joints.append({"name":name,"type":tname,"axis":axis,"ctrlrange":rng})
print("JOINTS")
for j in joints: print(j)

acts=[]
for i in range(m.nu):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR, i)
    trnid=m.actuator_trnid[i][0]
    jname=mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT, trnid)
    cr=list(map(float,m.actuator_ctrlrange[i])) if m.actuator_ctrllimited[i] else None
    acts.append({"name":name,"joint":jname,"ctrlrange":cr})
print("ACTS")
for a in acts: print(a)

print("SITES", [mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE,i) for i in range(m.nsite)])
print("nq",m.nq,"nv",m.nv,"neq",m.neq)
# free joint bodies
free=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    if m.jnt_type[i]==0:
        b=m.jnt_bodyid[i]
        free.append(mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,b))
print("FREE",free)
json.dump({"joints":joints,"acts":acts},open("_tmp.json","w"))
PY
